env._comment: A dev build loads its JS from Metro, so the URL that actually applies at runtime is EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL in mobile/.env — this value is only the build-time fallback. It must still not say localhost: on a phone that means the phone itself, not the dev machine. Both need the dev machine's LAN IP, which changes with the network.

Standalone APK — bakes this URL in at build time (no Metro). Points at the live Vercel backend so it works on any phone, anywhere. When a stable api.mvcleaningservices.in is set up on the backend project, switch to it and rebuild.

Play Store build. Prefer a stable custom domain (api.mvcleaningservices.in) here before submitting, since the API URL is baked in and changing it means a new build + resubmission. Using the Vercel URL for now.
